_help._note: Allowed values + requirements per field (this _help block is ignored by the gate — keep or delete). Run `plumb schema` for the full reference.
_help.task_id: required — ticket/issue/branch id (also the receipt filename)
_help.agent_id: required — which agent or human did the work
_help.intent: required — what + why, plain language — the semantic review reads this
_help.self_modifying: one of: true | false — required — MUST be true if changed_files touch policy.protected_paths; touching one with false is a hard fail; true escalates to human review
_help.validation_plan[].required: one of: true | false — required — is this check mandatory
_help.execution_evidence: required — each: { command, status, output_ref?, skip_reason? }
_help.execution_evidence[].status: one of: passed | failed | skipped — required — required steps must be 'passed'; use skip_reason when 'skipped'
_help.changed_files: required — set by `plumb receipt --write` — don't hand-edit
_help.diff_sha256: required — set by `plumb receipt --write` — never hand-edit
_help.result_summary: required — what changed + how it was verified

intent: Introduce the Plumbline proof-carrying gate to this repo, mirroring the working gate in amos-managed-platform. Adds a PR-only GitHub Actions workflow (status check 'Plumbline Gate') that graceful-degrades: full semantic review + PR comment when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set (it is on this repo), else `plumb check` for shape + diff-hash integrity. Adds .plumbline/MISSION.md grounded in THIS repo (open-source AMOS infra: pure-Rust harness/core/cli/packages; agent loop + prompt guard as the trust boundary, tools as capabilities, append-only migrations) and a policy.json whose protected_paths and ci_evidence_checks match this workspace's real layout and CI job names. Every future PR now carries a receipt the gate verifies.

validation_plan.reason: the workflow is new YAML; confirm it parses so Actions can load the job
policy.json must be valid JSON or the gate cannot load the policy
run the gate's own shape + diff-hash integrity check on this PR's receipt before pushing

execution_evidence.output_ref: see plumb check output in PR body / final report

result_summary: Added .github/workflows/plumbline.yml (status check 'Plumbline Gate', PR-only, graceful-degrade to `plumb check` without the key), .plumbline/MISSION.md written for this open-source AMOS-infra repo, and .plumbline/policy.json with protected_paths (agent loop, prompt_guard, tools, middleware, credentials/oauth/connections routes, migrations, tests, core, workflows, .plumbline, harness Dockerfile) and ci_evidence_checks matching ci.yml's real job names. Verified: plumbline.yml parses as YAML, policy.json parses as JSON, and `plumb check` passes on this receipt. self_modifying:true — the change touches .github/workflows/** and .plumbline/**, both protected paths, so the gate escalates to human review by design (a human/admin signs off in the PR).
